<TD VALIGN="top" STYLE="padding-bottom:6pt ;"> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">You are receiving this communication because you hold securities in The Middleby Corporation
(&#8220;Middleby&#8221;). Middleby has released informational materials that are now available for your review regarding the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">spin-off</FONT> of its wholly owned subsidiary, Midera Food Processing, Inc.
(&#8220;Midera&#8221;). To effect the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">spin-off,</FONT> Middleby will distribute all of the issued and outstanding shares of Midera common stock on a pro rata basis to the holders of Middleby common stock as of 4:00
p.m. Central Time on June 26, 2026, the record date for the distribution. Immediately following the distribution, Midera and Middleby will be two independent, publicly traded companies. <B>This notice provides instructions on how to access the
Information Statement that Midera has prepared in connection with the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">spin-off</FONT> (the &#8220;Information Statement&#8221;), which, together with this notice, is being provided FOR YOUR INFORMATION ONLY. You are
NOT required to respond or take any other action. Middleby is NOT soliciting a proxy or other consent from you in connection with the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">spin-off.</FONT> These materials are NOT a form for voting. The Information
Statement contains important information, and we encourage you to review it.</B></P> <P STYLE="font-size:6pt; margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:1pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">You
may view the materials online at <I>www.materialnotice.com</I><I> </I>and easily request a paper or <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">e-mail</FONT> copy (see reverse side).</P></TD></TR>
</TABLE>
